items.headline: Wizards, Anthony Davis Postpone Extension Talks
items.summary: Anthony Davis and the Washington Wizards have mutually agreed to delay discussions on a potential four-year, $275 million contract extension until after the 2026-27 NBA season. Both sides will evaluate the situation further before committing.

items.headline: Stephen Curry to Celtics Trade Rumors Debunked
items.summary: Recent speculative reports linking Stephen Curry to a trade to the Boston Celtics this summer have been widely debunked by reliable sources, highlighting the prevalence of unfounded rumors during the NBA offseason.

items.headline: Jonathan Kuminga's Lakers Trade Discussions 'Stuck'
items.summary: Trade talks involving Jonathan Kuminga and the Lakers are reportedly 'stuck' as the league's trade rumor mill experiences a lull. Kuminga remains a key name circulating in potential offseason deals.

items.headline: Saddiq Bey, Patrick Williams Surface in Trade Speculation
items.summary: Saddiq Bey of the Pelicans and Patrick Williams of the Bulls are among the players currently being discussed in trade rumors, as teams continue to explore roster adjustments ahead of the upcoming season.

items.headline: James Harden Expected to Re-Sign with Cavs
items.summary: Veteran guard James Harden is reportedly expected to finalize a deal to re-sign with the Cleveland Cavaliers, addressing one of the most notable remaining unrestricted free agents on the market.

items.headline: Duren, Watson Restricted Free Agency Stalemates Continue
items.summary: Restricted free agents Jalen Duren (DET) and Peyton Watson (DEN) face ongoing contract negotiations. Duren is being advised against taking a qualifying offer, while Watson's camp reportedly feels 'disrespected' by the Nuggets' offers, potentially leading to sign-and-trade scenarios involving teams like the Clippers and Bucks.

items.headline: Top Unrestricted Free Agents Still Available
items.summary: Several impact unrestricted free agents remain available, including DeMar DeRozan, Bradley Beal, Russell Westbrook, Bruce Brown, and Kelly Olynyk, as teams look to round out their rosters.

items.headline: 2026-27 NBA Schedule Release Expected This Month
items.summary: NBA fans eagerly await the release of the 2026-27 regular season schedule, which is traditionally unveiled in August. The season is slated to tip off in mid-to-late October.

items.headline: 2026 NBA Summer League Concludes in Las Vegas
items.summary: The 2026 NBA Summer League, held in Las Vegas, concluded on July 19th, showcasing top draft picks and emerging talent from across all 30 teams.

items.headline: Ice Cube Discusses BIG3 Expansion and NBA Partnership
items.summary: Rapper and BIG3 co-founder Ice Cube discussed his league's hopes for further expansion and a potential partnership with the NBA, envisioning the BIG3 as a major global basketball entity.
